description: Closed assetRole registry. Every media field in every section contract is const-locked to exactly one role; the enum here is the same set as definitions.assetRole in schema/pagespec.schema.json and assetRoles in tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json (verify_all.py checks parity).
scopeStatement: The assets and content are the REAL Transform9 company's, reused locally for private/internal use only (PROJECT_SCOPE.md). No redistribution. This registry governs two usage contexts, set per PageSpec in the usage field.

usageContexts.internal-clone: The private clone itself: exact reuse of the original assets and copy is the documented, scoped decision (PROJECT_SCOPE). Roles with must-not-fabricate may only reference existing files.
usageContexts.generated-derivative: AI-generated NEW pages or derivatives. MUST NOT reproduce real logos (client, partner, certification, third-party marks), real people's photos or names, real testimonials, real metrics/claims, real legal text, real product UI, or live endpoints (video ids). Such roles accept only placeholder tokens a human replaces with authorised assets; sections flagged claimsPolicy must-not-fabricate are rejected outright.

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: Generic, non-brand, non-person material that an AI may generate fresh (abstract textures, UI glyphs, atmospheric imagery with no identifiable real person). Never copy the original file bytes into generated output.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: The company's own brand mark: reference the existing file by path; never redraw, regenerate, recolour or restyle it.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Depicts or asserts something real (a real customer, partner, certification, person, third-party trademark, or real product UI). Never invent one; never reproduce one in generated output. Reuse of the original file is allowed only in the private internal clone.
generationPolicies.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Points at a live third-party endpoint (a real video id). Generated output must never carry the real id; only the private internal clone may, via the click-to-load facade (DEVIATIONS D4).

reuse.description: Web path of an existing file in the clone's public/assets store

generate.description: Request for a newly generated asset (slug names the intent)

placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in token; a human supplies the real, authorised asset

yt.description: YouTube video id (internal clone facade only)

forbiddenInGeneratedOutput: real certification badges (NIST, SOC 2) or implied compliance status
real people's photos, names, titles or quotes
real legal text (Terms, Privacy Policy, HIPAA)
live third-party video ids / form endpoints
the original asset files copied byte-for-byte

notReferencedByPageSpec.note: Licensed typeface of unknown licence terms; reuse is private/internal only (PROJECT_SCOPE). Not a node field.
Head meta images; the og image was not fetched. Not node fields.

brand.wordmark-white.description: White Transform9 wordmark: nav, popup, comparison-table header
brand.wordmark-white.licensing: Transform9 trademark (the real company). Private/internal reuse only (PROJECT_SCOPE); never redrawn.

brand.wordmark-black.description: Black Transform9 wordmark shown while the navbar is on white
brand.wordmark-black.licensing: Transform9 trademark (the real company). Private/internal reuse only (PROJECT_SCOPE); never redrawn.

brand.wordmark-footer.licensing: Transform9 trademark (the real company). Private/internal reuse only (PROJECT_SCOPE); never redrawn.

ui.icon.description: Generic UI glyphs: burger, close, arrows, tick
ui.icon.licensing: Simple geometric glyphs; regenerating is allowed, keep measured sizes 24px (burger/close/tick) and 28px (arrows).

ui.social-mark.description: X, Facebook and LinkedIn share icons
ui.social-mark.licensing: Third-party brand marks; never redrawn or invented. Share icons are inert (D13).

bg.video-loop.description: Fixed background pixel video (15.07s loop, 520x720, mp4/webm)
bg.video-loop.licensing: Abstract brand motion asset; in generated output create a new abstract loop, do not copy the original file.

bg.still-fallback.description: Still image shown while the video is not playing and under prefers-reduced-motion
bg.still-fallback.licensing: Abstract pixel still; generate a new one.

bg.section-image.description: Full-bleed section backgrounds and rail panels: CTA background, security rail, compare generic/privacy rails, stats rail gradient
bg.section-image.realWorldSubject: none (abstract renders; the CTA image is a non-identifiable silhouette)
bg.section-image.licensing: Generate new abstract or silhouette imagery; no identifiable real person.

stat.hover-image.description: Image revealed when a stats block is active

specialty.image.description: Image paired with a specialty tab
specialty.image.licensing: Generate new imagery; no identifiable real person or real patient.

editorial.hero-image.description: Blog article hero image (featured row, card, post header)
editorial.hero-image.realWorldSubject: photoreal scene imagery; no identifiable real person
editorial.hero-image.licensing: Generate a new image per article; never reuse a real article hero or depict a real, identifiable person.

product.ui-illustration.description: Product UI illustration for Scheduling, Tasking and Navigator agents (shows persona names such as Dr. Patel)
product.ui-illustration.licensing: Depicts real product capability; generating a new one would misrepresent the product. Reuse only in the private internal clone.

client.logo.description: Real client practice logos (marquee, testimonial, case cards/headers)
client.logo.licensing: Real customers' trademarks. Never invent a client logo; never reproduce one in generated output; reuse only inside the private internal clone.

constraints.variants: white and black (hover) versions on case cards

partner.logo.description: Real EMR / platform partner logos (Athena, NextGen, ModMed, Epic, Greenway, Nextech, Veradigm, eClinicalWorks, systemedx)
partner.logo.licensing: Third-party trademarks. Never redraw or invent; implying a partnership that does not exist is forbidden.

certification.badge.licensing: Certification marks assert a real compliance status. Never fabricate or approximate one.

person.photo.description: Testimonial portrait of a named real person
person.photo.licensing: Real people's likeness. Never generate or substitute a face for a real name; never reproduce in generated output.

embed.video.description: Click-to-load video facade: YouTube video id and its thumbnail
embed.video.realWorldSubject: a real client video hosted on YouTube
embed.video.licensing: Real third-party video and thumbnail. Generated output must use a placeholder, never the live id.

constraints.embed: iframe created only after user click (youtube-nocookie)
